concerns.text: FR-007 requires clamping k_est 'to a physically meaningful positive range bounded by a small lower threshold and a large upper limit' — neither bound is defined, so an implementer cannot know when the requirement is met. The Edge Cases section likewise says 'clamp the output to a defined range' without defining it. State the numeric bounds (or the procedure that fixes them, e.g., 'clamped to [1e-4, 10]') so the clamp is deterministically checkable.

'verify that the computed k_est correlates linearly with the ground-truth friction coefficient' states no evaluation criterion — no correlation measure, threshold, or judged procedure. Specify e.g. Pearson r ≥ some value across the sweep, or an explicit visual/regression inspection procedure, so the test has a pass/fail condition.

'a diverse set of novel articulated object geometries' is not verifiable — no count or diversity criterion. The idea doc specifies 10 novel objects; state the count (or a generation procedure with pinned seed) so FR-003 can be checked.

SC-003/SC-004 defer to 'the free-tier CI runner's time limit' and 'the RAM constraint of the target environment' without naming the reference values. US-3 already fixes ≤6 hours and 7GB — cite those explicit limits in the SCs so the measurement reference is unambiguous.
